resale_co.notes: Tavistock is a 0.28 square mile borough, mostly the Tavistock Country Club, with very few homes. Its website has no code book, construction page or resale CO information. Haddonfield provides construction and fire services under shared service agreements (Resolutions #33-2024 and #34-2024, renewed in general terms by Resolution #18-2026 on February 24, 2026). No Tavistock ordinance requiring a resale CO was found, and Haddonfield's own resale rules are Haddonfield Borough Code sections that apply to Haddonfield properties, not automatically to Tavistock. The Borough phone 856-429-0039 is on the Borough home page; office support is shared with Barrington.

authorities.name: Borough of Haddonfield Bureau of Fire Prevention (serving Tavistock under a shared service agreement)
authorities.how_to_apply: Contact the Haddonfield Fire Official (Ernest F. Busch) or the Haddonfield Construction and Zoning Office, Room 104, Haddonfield Borough Hall, which takes smoke detector compliance forms and payment for Haddonfield. Confirm the Tavistock process and fee before applying.

fire_cert.notes: The July 2026 LEA registry says Haddonfield Borough is the fire code enforcing agency for Tavistock, and the DCA fire directory lists Haddonfield's fire official Ernest F. Busch for Tavistock (smoke detector compliance phone (856) 429-4700, office (856) 429-4308). Tavistock is not on the DCA list of state smoke cert towns. Haddonfield's page publishes $56 / $125 / $201 smoke and CO fees and a portable fire extinguisher rule under Haddonfield Borough Code section 114-8(B) for Haddonfield properties; no source ties that fee to Tavistock properties, so no fee is listed here. The 2025 state law (P.L.2025, c.19) dropped the extinguisher from the state sale certificate.

open_questions: Which fee Haddonfield charges for a smoke/CO certificate on a Tavistock property, and whether the Haddonfield form is used.
Whether Tavistock has any resale CO or inspection ordinance; no Tavistock code book was found online. Ask the Borough Clerk (clerk@tavistocknj.org).
